title: fix(platform-objects, lint): the Business Unit page and the readScope hint say what needs the enterprise edition

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：业务单元页面说明改成「开源版里共享规则可以按业务单元共享、成员离开即失去；按业务单元读取全部记录需要企业版」；业务单元时区帮助不再声称日期按它计算；`os validate` 的 `security-private-no-readscope` 提示在项目没声明 `hierarchy-security` 时只建议 `org`，并写明另外三个范围需要企业包。
- 为什么改：管理员照页面和提示去配，结果开源版编译直接拒绝（#30210 第 1、2 行）；时区帮助说的事运行时根本没人读。
- 风险与回滚：只改说明文字和一条 info 级提示的 hint，编译拒绝、规则触发条件与级别都不变；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts`（`hierarchyScopesCompile` 那段）、`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-business-unit.object.ts`（description 与 timezone）、`zh-CN.objects.generated.ts` 两处中文。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-security-posture.test.ts -t hierarchy-security`，预期 2 条通过；无 `requires` 时 hint 只建议 `'org'` 并点名 `@objectstack/security-enterprise`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Refs #30210 (rows 1, 2)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none (`git grep` of `skills/**` for business unit, readScope and security-private-no-readscope: 6 hits in `skills/objectstack-data` — SKILL.md lines 73 and 388, rules/security.md lines 178 and 252, one eval; none states a sentence this diff makes false)

## What changes

- **Row 1 — Business Unit page.** `sys_business_unit.description` (the page text) said units are "used to scope data and reports". It now says what a unit does in the open edition (a sharing rule can share records with a unit, or a unit and the units under it; members get that access and lose it when they leave — measured on the card) and that letting a permission set read every record of a unit (read scope `unit`) needs the enterprise edition. The compile refusal (`validateHierarchyScopeCapability` in `stack.zod.ts`) is unchanged, as the card asks. zh-CN value hand-written; `en` regenerated by `pnpm i18n:extract`.
- **Seat amendment 6662593558 — Business unit Timezone help.** It said date boundaries are computed in this zone; nothing reads `sys_business_unit.timezone` (same reading as `sys_organization.timezone`, corrected in #25347). The help now says it changes no date calculation and names Settings → Localization → Default timezone, mirroring the organization's help. en + zh-CN. No field change.
- **Row 2 — `security-private-no-readscope` hint** (`packages/lint`, run by `os validate` / `os lint`). The rule now reads the stack's `requires` — the same declaration `defineStack` reads before refusing a hierarchy scope. With `hierarchy-security` declared, the hint is unchanged. Without it, the hint offers `readScope: 'org'` or widening `sharingModel`, and says `'own_and_reports'`, `'unit'` and `'unit_and_below'` need `requires: ['hierarchy-security']`, which `@objectstack/security-enterprise` provides. A stack with no `requires` (the runtime metadata door hands none) gets the requirement named too. Same grants fire, same `info` severity.

Not built here: **row 3** (Timezone on Edit organization) is measured only, per the order — removing a `sys_organization` field narrows an accept set and is the owning lane's ADR-0049 removal. **Row 4** (hide Parent Organization / Sort Order on one organization) stopped as `needs_decision`: field and field-group `visibleWhen` bind only `record` / `previous` / `parent` at authoring (`FIELD_RULE_BOUND_ROOTS`, `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`), and fields carry no `requiresFeature`, so hiding needs a new metadata capability. Both readings and the row 4 options are in the os-dev-report on the card.

## Tests

- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-business-unit-edition-copy.test.ts` (new): the description names sharing rules and the enterprise edition and drops the scoping claim; the zh-CN description says 共享规则 / 企业版; the Timezone help (en, zh-CN) says it changes no date calculation and names Localization's Default timezone.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.test.ts`: two cases in the existing `security-private-no-readscope` block — without `hierarchy-security`, the hint offers `'org'` before any hierarchy scope and names the requirement in the same sentence as all three; with it, every scope is offered and the enterprise package is not named. The #5017 key-surface meta-test now lists `requires` among the keys read off `stack` (declared by `ObjectStackSchema`).

## Acceptance notes

- The order's file surface named `packages/cli/src/**` for the advisory; it lives in `packages/lint`. The seat's amendment 6662593558 added `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts` and its tests.
- `pnpm i18n:extract` rewrote only `en`; ja-JP / es-ES kept their existing values (their source-hash ledgers do not cover these keys), and `check:i18n` / `check:i18n-stale-fill` are green.
- `sys_business_unit`'s docblock lists a `bu:` approver prefix in the approval engine; `plugin-approvals` has no such prefix on `main`. A code comment, not admin-facing — left alone.
